# Mobile Login Screen Accessibility Review

I'd be happy to review your mobile login screen for accessibility issues! However, I'll need you to provide the details first.

**Please share:**

1. **Screenshot or description** - An image of the login screen or a detailed description of its components
2. **Code/markup** - HTML, React, SwiftUI, Kotlin code, etc. (if applicable)
3. **Component details** - What elements are on the screen? (text fields, buttons, links, etc.)

## What I'll cover in my review:

Once you provide the materials, I'll evaluate against **WCAG 2.1** standards and identify:

- **Visual/contrast issues** (WCAG 1.4 - Distinguishable)
- **Interactive element problems** (WCAG 2.1, 2.5 - Operable)
- **Text alternatives** (WCAG 1.1 - Text Alternatives)
- **Touch target sizes** (WCAG 2.5.5 - Target Size)
- **Focus management** (WCAG 2.1.1 - Keyboard)
- **Color dependency issues** (WCAG 1.4.1 - Use of Color)
- **Form labeling** (WCAG 1.3.1 - Info and Relationships)

For each issue found, I'll explain:
- The **WCAG criterion** violated
- **Why** it's a problem for users
- **How to remediate** it

**Please share your login screen details, and I'll conduct a thorough accessibility review!**

# Mobile Login Screen Accessibility Review

I'd be happy to help review a mobile login screen for accessibility issues, but I don't see any materials provided (screenshot, code, design file, or description).

To conduct a thorough review, please share:

- **Visual:** Screenshot or design mockup
- **Code:** HTML/React/native code if available
- **Context:** Platform (iOS/Android/web), framework, current features

## Common Accessibility Issues I'll Check For:

**Input Fields**
- ✓ Proper labels associated with inputs (not just placeholders)
- ✓ Clear focus indicators
- ✓ Sufficient color contrast
- ✓ Form validation error messages are clear and linked to fields

**Buttons & Interactions**
- ✓ Adequate touch target size (min 44x44pt on mobile)
- ✓ Buttons have descriptive text (not just icons)
- ✓ Keyboard navigation support

**Text & Contrast**
- ✓ WCAG AA minimum contrast (4.5:1 for small text)
- ✓ Readable font size (16px+ recommended)

**Mobile-Specific**
- ✓ Works with screen readers (VoiceOver/TalkBack)
- ✓ No keyboard traps
- ✓ Proper zoom support

Please share the screen details, and I'll provide a detailed accessibility audit!

# Mobile Login Screen Accessibility Review

I'd be happy to help review your mobile login screen for accessibility issues! However, I need more information to provide a thorough review.

**Please provide:**
- Screenshots or code of the login screen
- Description of the UI elements (input fields, buttons, labels, error messages, etc.)
- Information about which platform(s) (iOS, Android, or web)
- Any existing accessibility implementations (like labels, hints, or semantic markup)

## In the meantime, here are common accessibility issues in mobile login screens:

| Issue | WCAG Criterion | Remediation |
|-------|----------------|-------------|
| **Missing labels** | 1.3.1 Info and Relationships | Associate text labels with form inputs using `<label>` or `aria-label` |
| **Low color contrast** | 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) | Ensure text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text, 3:1 for large text |
| **No error indication for screen readers** | 3.3.1 Error Identification | Use `aria-describedby` to link errors to inputs; announce errors to assistive tech |
| **Non-descriptive button text** | 2.4.4 Link Purpose | Use "Log In" instead of "Submit"; ensure button purpose is clear |
| **Keyboard navigation issues** | 2.1.1 Keyboard | Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible with logical tab order |
| **Insufficient touch targets** | 2.5.5 Target Size | Make buttons/fields at least 44x44 CSS pixels |
| **Missing password visibility toggle** | 1.3.1 & 1.4.13 | Provide option to show/hide password without losing input |

**Please share the login screen details, and I'll provide specific recommendations with WCAG criteria.**

- ✓ Proper labels and form associations
- ✓ Clear placeholder text (not replacing labels)
- ✓ Sufficient touch target size (48x48dp minimum)

- ✓ Readable font size (minimum 16px recommended)
- ✓ No reliance on color alone to convey information

### Interaction
- ✓ Keyboard navigation support
- ✓ Error messages are clear and associated with fields
- ✓ "Show/Hide Password" button functionality
- ✓ Screen reader compatibility

### Buttons & Links
- ✓ Adequate button size for touch
- ✓ Clear, descriptive button labels
- ✓ Visual feedback on interaction
